name: vllm_fused_add_rms_norm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_fused_add_rms_norm.py. Fused residual-add + RMSNorm: in-place op that sets residual := input + residual and input := rmsnorm(residual) * weight. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.fused_add_rms_norm(input, residual, weight, epsilon) and returns the mutated input (the normalized output the test asserts on). input (M,N), residual (M,N), weight (N,) are plain random; epsilon is a scalar. Source parametrizes dtype in {fp16,bf16,fp32} and epsilon in {1e-6,1e-5,1e-4}; migrated workloads fix epsilon=1e-5. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
